## About

MyAppliance Repair LLC is a Connecticut-based appliance repair company. We provide fast, reliable repair services for all major home appliances. Our technicians are licensed, insured, and experienced with all major brands including Samsung, LG, Whirlpool, GE, Maytag, Bosch, KitchenAid, and Frigidaire. Every repair comes with a 90-day parts and labor warranty.

## Services

- Refrigerator Repair — all makes and models, including ice maker and cooling issues
- Washer Repair — spin failures, leaks, error codes, drum problems
- Dryer Repair — no heat, drum not spinning, long dry times
- Dishwasher Repair — not cleaning, not draining, door latch, control board issues
- Oven & Range Repair — gas and electric, ignition failures, uneven heating
- Air Conditioner Repair — window units, portable ACs, mini-splits

## Service Area

We serve the greater New Haven County area and surrounding Connecticut communities, including:

New Haven, Hamden, West Haven, East Haven, North Haven, Woodbridge, Orange, Bethany, Branford, Milford, Shelton, Derby, Ansonia, Naugatuck, Cheshire, Meriden, Wallingford
